51228397.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full-length human PRDX1 by surface plasmon resonance analysis
51228397.references_previous: Reference 30: Wang, J.; Chen, F.; Liu, Y.; Liu, Y.; Li, K.; Yang, X.; Liu, S.; Zhou, X.; Yang, J. Spirostaphylotrichin X from a marine-derived fungus as an anti-influenza agent targeting RNA polymerase PB2. J. Nat. Prod. 2018, 81, 2722–2730.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 5.11. SPR Assay: The SPR measurement was performed on the Biacore T100 system (GE Healthcare). Full-length human PRDX1 was immobilized on a CM5 chip (GE healthcare) in 10 mM HEPES (pH 7.4) for giving a concentration series. PA/GPA samples were dispensed into single-used snap-capped vials and injected across the protein and the protein-free (control) surfaces in a single step. Compound binding with PRDX1 was analyzed in a single-cycle kinetic analysis range from 1 to 10 μM PA and 1 to 20 μM GPA, respectively. The K_D values were calculated using dynamic fitting equation.30
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Figure 4. Molecular docking and SPR analysis of PA/GPA with PRDX1. (A1) Dimer–dimer interface region (PDB entry 2Z9S) was used as the receptor structure. Each chain of monomers is shown in different colors. Chains a, b as a dimer and chains c, d as another dimer. The CYS83–CYS83 disulfide bridge is located between chains a and c. (A2) Binding sites and the details of the predicted binding mode of PA in the dimer–dimer interface of PRDX1 (2Z9S), 90° rotation from (A1). (A3) Binding sites and the details of the predicted binding mode of GPA in the dimer–dimer interface of PRDX1 (2Z9S). The contact residues are shown and labeled by type and number. (B) Affinity activities of PA (B1) and GPA (B2) to the PRDX1 protein were analyzed using the SPR assay.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 B1 and B2 sensorgrams: B1: PA/PRDX1, K_D = 2.61 × 10⁻⁶ M. B2: GPA/PRDX1, K_D = 1.83 × 10⁻⁶ M. The x-axis (Time) ranges from -10 to 160 s. The y-axis (Response) ranges from -1 to 5 RU. The curves are labeled with concentrations: 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000 nM for PA; 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000 nM for GPA.
original_paragraph.Results section - 2.4. Docking Analysis: The dissociation equilibrium constants (K_D) of the PRDX1 protein with PA (2.61 × 10⁻⁶ M) and GPA (1.83 × 10⁻⁶ M), measured by a surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay (Figure 4B), revealed the affinity interaction between PA/GPA and PRDX1 protein (Figure 4B1,B2).

analyte.concentration_range: 1 to 10 μM PA and 1 to 20 μM GPA
